entities.name: Starke
entities.description: A scheming informant who serves both sides, betrayed Sisay to Volrath, and murders Maraxus to protect himself.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A dark-skinned nobleman obsessed with finding the angel Selenia, whom Starke tricks into leaving his family and who later joins Gerrard.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: An angel whom Crovax pursues and whom Starke says he saw once in Rath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: An evincar whose forces hunt Starke and who holds Starke's daughter prisoner.

entities.name: Maraxus
entities.description: Volrath's masked warlord and mercenary, who draws strength from those around him, hunts Starke with sawtooth ogres and is killed by Starke.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, whom Starke helped Volrath take prisoner.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: The man Starke seeks, who rescues Starke, fights Maraxus and distrusts Starke while needing him to reach Rath.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur who travels with Gerrard and carries the weakened Starke.

entities.name: Alaric
entities.description: A friend of Crovax who hides Starke in his wine cellar and is killed by Maraxus's forces.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The flying ship that falls on the ogres in the canyon and picks up Gerrard's party.

entities.name: Sawtooth ogres
entities.description: The ogres of Maraxus's platoon, who loot Alaric's mansion and attack Gerrard's group.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The place where Starke says he saw Selenia and where Sisay is presumed held.

events.summary: Starke lies to Crovax that he knows nothing of a letter but has seen Selenia in Rath, then tells him the letter was a trick to draw him away from his family.
events.quote: You were lured away from your home and from protecting your family.

events.summary: Starke urges Crovax to go home, and Crovax realizes he left his family alone and stumbles off, cursed.
events.quote: I left them alone just so I could find Selenia. I am cursed,

events.summary: Starke decides to seek allies after learning Gerrard is no longer aboard the Weatherlight.
Starke recalls how Maraxus forced him to help take Sisay prisoner, yet Volrath and Maraxus still refused to free him or his daughter.
events.quote: He had gained nothing by betraying Sisay

events.summary: Starke finds Crovax and begs him to hide him from the warlord sent to kill him; Crovax sends him on to his friend Alaric.
events.quote: I have a friend, Alaric, who will hide you.

events.summary: Maraxus's forces drag Starke out of Alaric's wine cellar and tear down Alaric's mansion.
events.quote: Maraxus's forces tore down Alaric's elegant mansion in the canyons

events.summary: Maraxus tells Starke that Alaric is dead and that Volrath is not through with him, and orders him taken to camp.
events.quote: "Your friend who hides you is dead," Maraxus said simply.

events.summary: Gerrard, Tahngarth and Crovax, who rescued Starke from Maraxus's camp, walk through a canyon and Tahngarth carries the weakened Starke.
events.quote: since the trio had rescued Starke from Maraxus of Keld's camp

events.summary: Starke whispers to Gerrard that Maraxus has a secret that might kill him.
Maraxus and his ogre platoon find the sleeping group at dawn and attack, demanding Starke.
events.quote: "Give me the traitor," Maraxus demanded of Gerrard

events.summary: The Weatherlight drops from above into the ogres, scattering them and killing most of them, leaving only Maraxus.
events.quote: And then the Weatherlight fell from above, dropping amidst the ogres, scattering them like leaves on the breeze.

events.summary: Gerrard sends Tahngarth, Crovax and Starke to the ship to leave him alone against Maraxus, whose strength depends on those around him.
events.quote: that you draw your strength from whatever's around you, whoever's near. Look around. You're alone.

events.summary: Gerrard duels Maraxus and wounds him, and Maraxus's strength drains away.
events.quote: Gerrard landed a clean cut across the warlord's sword arm.

events.summary: Starke, hiding behind a boulder, stabs Maraxus in the back of the neck, and Maraxus falls dead.
events.quote: searching blindly for the dagger buried at the base of his neck

events.summary: Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, and offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom.
events.quote: I can lead you to Rath,

events.summary: Gerrard says he has no reason to trust Starke but needs him to reach Rath, and will watch him constantly.
events.quote: I have no reason at all to trust you, Starke.

relations.quote: And then came Maraxus, Volrath's mercenary

relations.note: Stabs him in the neck with a dagger.
relations.quote: waiting for the moment to free himself from Maraxus by murdering him.

relations.note: He helped Maraxus and Volrath take her prisoner.
relations.quote: They had taken Sisay—and Starke had helped them.

relations.note: He hunts Starke on Volrath's orders.
relations.quote: "Volrath is not through with you," he said.

relations.note: He travels with Gerrard's party and serves as its scout and rear guard.
relations.quote: exchanged a weary glance with Crovax, who was serving as rear guard

relations.note: He fights beside Gerrard and carries Starke at his request.
relations.quote: "You should carry him, Tahngarth," Gerrard said.

relations.note: Crovax calls him a friend who will hide Starke.
relations.quote: I have a friend, Alaric, who will hide you.
